mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1600 units, coupled with rising GDP (GDPC1), indicates strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or correlation between HOUST and GDPC1 drops below 0.4 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.1% signals an accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A drop in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5%, accompanied by rising payroll employment (PAYEMS), signals a tightening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or correlation between UNRATE and PAYEMS drops below -0.5 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 102, coupled with rising retail sales (RSAFS), indicates strengthening supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or correlation between INDPRO and RSAFS drops below 0.5 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 280, indicating rising demand-side inflation, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in high-inflation periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increase above 0.15% signals a monetary tightening cycle, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or FEDFUNDS remains above 0.15% for less than 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 148000, coupled with a drop in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5%, signals a labor market at full employment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or correlation between PAYEMS and UNRATE drops below -0.4 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2% YoY, accompanied by rising housing starts (HOUST), indicates a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in robust demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
